properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Private Endpoint: Services Must Use Private Endpoints
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure services that support Private Endpoints without a Private Endpoint configuration. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7) — all supported services must use Private Endpoints to ensure traffic traverses the Microsoft backbone and private VNet instead of public internet paths. This is a generic template policy; service-specific Private Endpoint enforcement policies are referenced in each service's built-in-references.md.

metadata.description: Deny: Block services without Private Endpoint. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
The Azure resource type to enforce Private Endpoint on (e.g., 'Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts').
